bullets_ur: Waziran-e-Ala ka 26/11 ke shohada ko kharaj-e-aqeedat, dehshatgardi ke khilaf azm ka izhaar.
1991 se 2003 ke darmiyan J&K se farar honay walay 30 afraad ab Pakistan se terror ops chala rahay hain.
